_comment: Test-fixture plugin repos for the plugin-scan POC. The working copies under repos/<name>/ are gitignored; regenerate them with the `clone` command below. `purpose` records why the repo is in the set.

repos.name: superpowers
repos.why: Widely installed real Claude Code plugin. Exercises every component we care about: a SessionStart command hook (hooks/hooks.json + hooks/run-hook.cmd + hooks/session-start) that injects context into the model on every session, ~15 skills with aggressive imperative language, and bundled runnable scripts (skills/brainstorming/scripts/server.cjs, start-server.sh, etc.). Also ships parallel non-Claude manifests (.codex-plugin, .cursor-plugin, .devin-plugin, .hermes-plugin) which are out of scope but useful for testing that the scanner only reads the Claude surface.

e2e_install.note: source '.' -> the whole repo is copied to the plugin cache. discover_assets.py accounts for all 194 (177 assets + 18 explicit exclusions). Verified 2026-09-05.

repos.name: impeccable
repos.why: Monorepo (Rust engine + browser extension + npm CLI + ~2960 files) that ALSO ships a plugin. The Claude Code marketplace entry has source './plugin', so only the plugin/ subdir (58 files) is installed — not the whole repo. Exercises: subdir marketplace source, ~18 per-harness standalone skill copies at the repo root, PostToolUse+Stop hooks that exec a platform binary, a skill-source dir, and separately-distributed components (extension/, cli/, crates/) that are NOT plugin assets. Also ships .hermes/ (excluded).

e2e_install.note: source './plugin' -> only plugin/** is copied. discover_assets.py's marketplace surface = the same 58 files, 0 unaccounted. Component inventory (1 skill / 4 agents / 2 hook entries) matches `claude plugin details`. Verified 2026-09-05.
